'''Headquarters''' was the company town established by [[Verkuylian BactaCo]] when the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Verkuyl]] was settled. Located on the [[Dalos Peninsula]], the majority of the planet's population lived in the settlement. The [[Verkuylian Imperial Governor's Hall]] was located in Headquarters.<ref name="COI" />
